overview_description.description: 64x Bio develops biotechnology platforms and production systems for advanced therapies. Its VectorSelect platform combines parallelized screening with computational analysis to engineer cell lines and production technologies. The AAV Apex Suite supports adeno-associated virus production across serotypes, payloads, and manufacturing scales. The LV Apex Suite supports lentiviral vector production for ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T programs. The company also describes a biologics production suite for antibodies and protein therapeutics.
